scenes.label: KYOTO SENTO SAUNA
scenes.head: 3 bathhouse saunas in Kyoto
scenes.body: Entry is 550 yen. No booking. Just bring a towel.

scenes.label: 01  MIYAKO-YU SHIMABARA
scenes.head: Two cold baths: 18°C and a gentle 20–25°C
scenes.body: Good if cold plunges scare you. 15:00–1:00, closed Wed.

scenes.label: 02  GOKOU-YU
scenes.head: A sauna inside a sauna: 85°C, then 110°C
scenes.body: Warm up in the first room. Open the inner door if you dare. Closed Mon and 3rd Tue.

scenes.label: 03  SAUNA NO UMEYU
scenes.head: The easiest first sento
scenes.body: 100°C sauna, two cold baths, by the Takase River. Closed Thu.

scenes.label: BEFORE YOU GO
scenes.head: Wash first. Keep your towel out of the bath.
scenes.body: Hours change, so check each bath before you go.

scenes.label: SAVE THIS
scenes.head: Send it to your sauna buddy.
